function: Involved in the regulation of endocytosis and in several stages of intracellular trafficking (PubMed:12668730, PubMed:17994011, PubMed:32513819, PubMed:33468622). Plays a role in recycling endocytosed transferrin receptor and prevent its degradation (PubMed:17994011). Involved in autophagosome assembly by regulating trafficking and recycling of phospholipid scramblase ATG9A (PubMed:32513819, PubMed:33468622).
subcellular_location: Early endosome membrane; Peripheral membrane protein; Cytoplasmic side; Also detected on a juxtanuclear endocytic recycling compartment (ERC).
subunit: Heterodimer; heterodimerizes with SNX7 or SNX30 (PubMed:32513819). Interacts with SNX32 (PubMed:37158588). Interacts with WWC1/KIBRA (PubMed:17994011). Identified in a complex with WWC1/KIBRA and dynein components DYNLL1 and DYNC1I2 (PubMed:17994011). Interacts with BIN1 (PubMed:12668730).
similarity: Belongs to the sorting nexin family.

function: Sorting nexin, involved in the separation or division of vacuoles throughout the entire life cycle of the cells (By similarity). Involved in retrieval of late-Golgi SNAREs from post-Golgi endosomes to the trans-Golgi network, for cytoplasm to vacuole transport (Cvt), and autophagy of large cargos including mitophagy, pexophagy and glycophagy (PubMed:35835849). Required for the switch to necrotrophic growth (PubMed:35835849).
subcellular_location: Cytoplasm; Cytosol; Preautophagosomal structure membrane; Peripheral membrane protein; Endosome membrane; Mitochondrion membrane; Lipid droplet; Endosome and other perivacuolar punctate structures. Associates to phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate, necessary for peripheral membrane localization to the perivacuolar punctate structures (By similarity). Found at lipid droplets and mitochondria during nitrogen starvation (PubMed:35835849).
subunit: Interacts with the mitochondrial prohibitin complex subunits PHB1 and PHB2; the interaction is direct and plays a role in mitophagy.
similarity: Belongs to the sorting nexin family.

function: Sorting nexin, involved in the separation or division of vacuoles throughout the entire life cycle of the cells. Involved in retrieval of late-Golgi SNAREs from post-Golgi endosomes to the trans-Golgi network and autophagy of large cargos including mitophagy, pexophagy and glycophagy (By similarity). Acts as crucial component for prohibitin-mediated mitophagy triggered by both nitrogen deprivation and a mitophagy-specific activator (By similarity). Plays pivotal roles in modulating hyphal growth, conidiation, microsclerotia formation, and virulence (PubMed:40729315). Contributes to fungal virulence through the promotion of host colonization via mediating melanin biosynthesis, facilitatinges protein secretion during the infection process, and indirectly attenuating host immunity (PubMed:40729315).
